summary.headline: Saturnine Planetary Combinations
summary.text: Astrological judgments on planetary combinations: Saturn with Mars and Mercury signifies crimes, fraud, trials, reversals, struggles, disgrace, imprisonment, blasphemy, and possible success in financial or military matters; Saturn with the Sun and Venus signifies associations, honors, leadership, losses, betrayals, and unstable unions; Saturn with Venus and the Moon brings instability, malice, rivalry, factions, separations, and illicit actions, especially involving wife, mother, and children.
